# sitemap

Display the sitemap navigation structure of an app

## Usage

```
ppds model-driven-app sitemap [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` |  | `string` |  | [Required] App display name or unique name |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--environment` | `-e` | `string` |  | Environment URL override |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--raw` |  | `bool` |  | Output the raw sitemap XML instead of the parsed navigation structure |
| `--unpublished` |  | `bool` |  | Read the unpublished (latest draft) sitemap instead of the published version |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
